source_effect_records.display_vi: Bách Niên Thụ Tâm

source_effect_records.display_vi: Thần Cách Quang Minh

source_effect_records.display_vi: Quần Bộ Cổ Hàn Đông
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Observed purchased orange-set trousers: each incoming attack triggers a magical shield at 100% proc rate, mitigating 27% magical damage. The panel was inspected after purchase; do not apply the effect to the entire three-piece set or other set parts.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Ủng Bộ Cổ Hàn Đông
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Observed purchased orange-set boots: on casting magical skills, a 30% chance to increase that skill attack damage by 50%; no effect on zero-cost Tử Phục and no global damage multiplier.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Hàn Đông Giáng Lâm — hiệu ứng bộ 3 món
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Three-piece 古寒冬 equipment-set activated effect: 3000 m DIAMETER centered on wearer; temperature falls by 20–30°C without applying this temperature harm to allies, strong snow interferes with enemy vision/mobility, friendly ice-attribute attack +30% damage and +30% attack range; duration 120 s; cooldown 1 hour. Do not interpret diameter as radius or make it passive.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Rương Xích Tiêu — thông tin thưởng từ mô tả vật phẩm
source_effect_records.observed_effect: On opening, chance 100% to gain one or more legendary-grade equipment, props, scrolls, blueprints, etc. The inspected source also says an extremely rare chance of one demigod-grade equipment/prop, but supplies no numeric probability, distribution, number of additional rewards, or guarantee that the source-world map contains this specific chest in LL01.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Thần Hỏa Quang Minh — cơ chế thanh tẩy và tương thích
source_effect_records.observed_effect: The observed Light God flame is a battle drop separate from the S-rank quest's staged awards. Light-aligned legendary-to-demigod advancement is compatible; other systems reduce breakthrough success relative to aligned users. The source explicitly permits purification into Pure Divine Flame by spending 2,000 divine-power points.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 龙晶战士战甲、下装、头盔、战靴、护臂（蓝）

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 紫晶战士战甲、下装、头盔、战靴、护臂（紫）

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 神秘水晶战甲、下装、头盔、战靴、护臂（金）

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 上古巨龙：克拉卡托的鳞片
source_effect_records.display_vi: Vảy Cự Long Krakato — hiệu ứng khi thẩm định
source_effect_records.observed_effect: The inspected scale is described with Crystal Power, immunity to all lightning-attribute attacks, and Furious Dragon, reflection of 50% of damage upon being attacked. source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 上古巨龙：克拉卡托之血
source_effect_records.display_vi: Huyết Cự Long Krakato — điều kiện hòa huyết và chuyển chức
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Fusion can cause a dragon-series hidden-class transformation with unspecified attribute increases and extra skills. The inspected blood accepts either survivors or residents. An actor below legendary grade is stated to suffer certain body explosion (100%). Legendary qualification is a minimum gate, NOT automatic success; subsequent character assessment in Ch889 was under 20%.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 伯捷·逐日者尝试融合克拉卡托之血 — 风险评估
source_effect_records.display_vi: Đánh giá hòa huyết lần thứ tư của Bá Tiệp — trường hợp riêng
source_effect_records.observed_effect: At newly reached legendary grade, the named actor Bojie, already bearing three dragon-bloodline powers, self-assesses a fourth blood fusion chance below 20%. Improving to high legendary or mutant ruler potential is said to improve prospects and turn a failure into severe backlash rather than instant body explosion. Cao Xing postpones consumption; no successful fourth fusion is observed in this passage.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: This is an actor-specific risk estimate, not a universal 20% recipe for all legendary blood recipients. The safer-condition improvement is unquantified and not an immediate success guarantee.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 专家级冰霜城墙建造图纸

Expert wall 1,500 armor and 100,000 durability. Expert Frost Aura within 100 m gives nearby allied units +300 armor and reduces damage received by wall by 30%. Whether multiple wall auras stack is not stated.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: No evidence of free construction or learned blueprint at T0. Do not treat the aura as unconditional territory-wide defense, multiplicatively stacking wall bonuses, or a general arrow-tower effect. Ch522 is an observed source purchase; keep the existing SX-0016 price/listing.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 永冻之海冰巢怪战场掉落类别
source_effect_records.display_vi: Trận Vĩnh Đống Hải — phân loại chiến lợi phẩm quan sát được
source_effect_records.observed_effect: After more than ten million kills, source narrates that the Ice Nest enemies, being shaped from dragon and ice power, did not drop normal equipment and instead yielded mainly materials and stat books; the 11 enumerated collection totals are observed one-time inventory increments. This describes THAT battle and monster family; the report offers no independent loot rate, guaranteed quantity, individual encounter instance list, chest contents, corpse persistence or revival eligibility. Ice Dragon Marks also appear as drops even when Dragon Shop reopening is still a character conjecture.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not generalize to unrelated mobs; no item or corpse instantly appears in LL01. The statement does not establish how Tử Phục applies to these kills.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Vòng Quay Truyền Thuyết Ẩn — bảng tỷ lệ và điều kiện mở
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Unique first-survivor with more than 1,000,000 unspent challenge points opens a hidden legendary wheel; each draw costs 1,000,000 points. Panel outcome partitions: 50% one legendary-category item (weapon/equipment/prop/herb etc.), 30% two epic items, 15% three epic items, 5% a complete epic equipment set. Four probabilities total 100%; specific legendary item identities/epic pool weights unknown. The source shop closes at 00:00 following tenth qualifier day, while challenge rank locks at 22:00 on that last day; NOT source-proof of matching fixed LL01 hour offsets.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: This expands already extracted SX-0049, NOT a duplicate paid offer. Chance applies to result category, never to one selected named item. Do not pre-assign first-world ownership or overwrite v0.6 open/lock/resolve clock.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Bộ Ngưng Huyết Kinh Cức — mua món lẻ hoặc trọn bộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Five pieces; each costs 500 War Merit; complete discounted set costs 2,000. Shop says 不限量 (unlimited supply for the listing), not a free item.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Complete set already in SX-0069; per-piece and set prices must remain two purchase modes of the same family.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Bộ Xích Huyết Liêu Nha — mua món lẻ hoặc trọn bộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Four pieces; each 3,000 War Merit; full set 10,000 War Merit; listed unlimited supply.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: No double-award of stand-alone pieces; stock mode is a single set family.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Bộ Huyết Diệm Chuẩn Ưng — mua món lẻ hoặc trọn bộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Four pieces; each 20,000 War Merit; full set 70,000; panel displays 限量兑换5000套. Cap scope is not proven independently for individual pieces or globally.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: No per-slot cap multiplication or new guaranteed four-item loot bundle from research.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Bộ Huyết Nham Bích Lũy — mua món lẻ hoặc trọn bộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Five pieces; each 100,000 War Merit; full set 450,000; panel limits 100 complete sets, cap scope unknown.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Old SX-0072 listing is already the same full-set offer; not an additional inventory family.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Bộ Dung Huyết Thái Thản — mua món lẻ hoặc trọn bộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Five pieces; each 500,000 War Merit; full set 2,200,000; limit 10 complete sets, cap scope unknown.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: No fabricated additional orange-set offer; this is an alternate price mode of SX-0073.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 幸运之神的眷顾（S级）隐藏任务与神眷之章
source_effect_records.display_vi: Nhiệm Vụ Ẩn Thần May Mắn — điều kiện, hai giai đoạn xác nhận, giai đoạn ẩn
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Quest unlock: first-ever survivor lord with Luck at full 200; must own 1 demigod artifact or source wording 5件以上 legendary pieces; lord level above 100 per original phrasing. Stage 1: reach listed Luck Altar coordinates, provide unspecified offering, pass Fortune Wheel, receive legendary Luck Sacred Altar blueprint and 100 divine power fragments. Stage 2: kill demigod Misfortune Beast Modis at source coordinates, receive Luck God's Dice (quality unknown) and 100 divine power fragments. Stage 3 hidden activates when finishing critical hit on Modis; its reward panel explicitly says UNKNOWN. Listed rewards are unclaimed contract announcements rather than completed receipts.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Chiêu Mộ Dân Cư Qua Tửu Quán — kích hoạt và tìm người
source_effect_records.observed_effect: A constructed tavern does NOT immediately run recruitment. Activated local recruitment broadcasts to roaming civilians/visitors within 50 km, reputation affects recruitment, and can be used once every three days. Tavern upgrades may improve range and reduce cooldown but exact upgraded values are not supplied. Incoming wanderers require the lord's approval to join; a broadcast is not an instant NPC summon or forced migration.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not create NPCs at zero travel time and do not treat the named novel bartender Laqi as a free LL01 starter unit. Staff, travel, reputation, open slots and acceptance must be modeled separately when activated.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 声望值界面与希望之地头衔：酒馆招募概率
source_effect_records.display_vi: Danh Vọng 1.100 và Danh Hiệu Đất Hy Vọng — xác suất ví dụ chiêu mộ
source_effect_records.observed_effect: At exactly 1,100 reputation the source character's recruitment panel lists base elite chance 5%, head-grade chance 1%, leader-grade chance 0.01%. Its Hope Land title applies an ADDITIVE +5 percentage points to EACH of those three grade-chance lines, displaying 5%+5%, 1%+5%, 0.01%+5%. This is one named character/status snapshot, not a global reputation-to-probability curve, not a normalized categorical distribution, and not the separate 荣耀之地 title in SX-0228.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not combine elite/head/leader display values into a 3-way categorical sampler without the missing rules; the Hope Land source title is NOT the same as the existing 'Territory Honor' title SX-0228. No free title at T0.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 更新内容⑥：医疗包不可一键使用、设施须专业人员
source_effect_records.display_vi: Cập Nhật Hệ Thống — Túi Y Tế và Công Trình cần nhân sự chuyên môn
source_effect_records.observed_effect: After the novice-protection period update, medical kits can no longer be consumed as a one-click instant heal. A suitable medical professional must apply the kit's contents to treat injuries. Sewing shops and smithies similarly need trained technicians to function. The notice does not define treatment time, number of materials consumed, skill thresholds for all stations, wage bill or a fixed failure rate.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not handwave an unattended medical center/forge into automatic output; player must have actual qualified personnel and valid items. No original clean-T0 residents or structures are changed.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 更新内容⑦⑧：装备掉落与肢体伤残
source_effect_records.display_vi: Cập Nhật Hệ Thống — giới hạn trang bị chiến lợi phẩm và thương tật
source_effect_records.observed_effect: The system notice forbids equipment dropping from an enemy that was not wearing equipment; this does not forbid non-equipment materials and other drops. Combat gains limb severing, permanent/severe disabling injuries and vital-point attacks with increased damage; severed limbs cannot be restored by ordinary healing magic according to this notice. No exact rates, body-slot tables, vital-hit multipliers or regeneration exceptions are given.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: The patch concerns source physical injury/loot semantics. It does not define Tử Phục's separate corpse eligibility, negate magical transformation/regrowth exceptions or retroactively reroll LL01 fixed chest instances.

source_effect_records.display_vi: Sừng Băng Long Trung — mô tả được kiểm tra
source_effect_records.observed_effect: The source inspected medium Ice Dragon Horn explicitly runs six hours and draws Ice Nests originally within 60 km of the territory to the vicinity when activated. The excerpt does not enumerate an XP/drop-rate mode or exact position/arrival schedule for this medium item. Named source line is 冰龙之角（中）, while existing ch206/ch281 observed chest copies are labeled 冰龙号角（中）; equivalence must be checked, not assumed. Do not spawn new nests, clone previously seeded mobs or teleport world anchors under fixed LL01 geography.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Ch171 source effect is real but does NOT authorize rearranging pre-T0 fixed mobs/chests, doubling source nests or assuming small-horn loot/XP effect modes for the medium horn.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 酒馆第二次招募，冷却完毕
source_effect_records.display_vi: Tửu Quán Chiêu Mộ — lần kích hoạt sau hồi lại

This confirms the recruit broadcast is repeatable after cooldown, not a one-time unique recruitment entitlement; the chapter excerpt does not establish guaranteed recruit arrivals, travel times or recruitment distribution.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 闪耀王座：四项附带特效
source_effect_records.display_vi: Vương Tọa Rực Sáng — bốn hiệu ứng khóa theo Nhà Lãnh Chúa
source_effect_records.observed_effect: An unowned epic (orange) Shining Throne is bindable to a lord. Binding yields Charm +50. After placement in territory and level-2 Lord House, bound lord receives Luck +10. With level-3 Lord House, King's Blessing affects territory-wide friendly units: source line claims attack and armor enhancement around 30% but is TEXTUALLY MALFORMED ('可增加领地所有友方单位30%和攻击力和30%护甲'); use source raw wording until clarified, do not auto-add health or unprinted stats. After level-4 Lord House, the placed throne can cast Shining Star once every seven natural days to locate ONE area with valuable resources; whether it reveals exact coordinates, guaranteed resource rarity, range, and uniqueness is unstated.
source_effect_records.kings_blessing_attack_raw_source: 可增加领地所有友方单位30%和攻击力和30%护甲
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: This is an existing palace object, NOT a building blueprint; binding, placing and house level are independent. Do not invent hidden HP bonus from garbled buff phrase; do not give throne to Lí Lan at clean T0. Site discovery does not magically mine resources.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 国王祭坛建造图纸：建造材料与复活次数上限
source_effect_records.display_vi: Tế Đàn Quốc Vương — nguyên liệu xây và hạn mức hồi sinh
source_effect_records.observed_effect: King's Altar gold blueprint creates a special territory structure at level-3 Lord House: 10,000 wood, 5,000 stone, 1,000 mithril, 100 eternal-gold ingots, 50 magic-pattern stones. It records fallen qualified hero souls and consumes a same-tier soul and substantial additional resurrection resources. Same individual hero may be revived at most three times. The blueprint does not give a per-resurrection resource formula, timing, chance, cooldown or universal all-corpse legality; built altar later specifies Soul Sand explicitly.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Building this structure must consume materials and a blueprint acquisition. Its return-from-death mechanism is NOT Tử Phục, not Ngôi Mộ output and not a globally enabled lord talent. Blueprint header label 英雄祭坛 is chapter title, not panel item identity.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 国王祭坛：建成后的属性与准入条件
source_effect_records.display_vi: Tế Đàn Quốc Vương — điều kiện thực tế sau hoàn công
source_effect_records.observed_effect: After actual construction, King's Altar special building inspection shows Armor 500 and Durability 3,000. It pre-records territory residents with Loyalty exactly 100 and potential leader-grade or above (首领级以上潜力), then revives eligible dead registered members by consuming a SOUL OF THE SAME TIER and SOUL SAND. Blueprint's three-lifetime-revivals-per-hero rule remains applicable. No observed per-revival Soul Sand count, build time, time-to-revive, actor recovery state or guaranteed successful resurrection is given in this scene.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Only pre-registered qualifying residents; no auto-raise of arbitrary enemy corpses, no bypassing loyalty and potential requirements. This mechanism cannot be substituted for fixed SSS Tử Phục; source reports building functional description, not an actual completed revival receipt.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 中级力量之心：二十级突破三阶及基础属性增幅
source_effect_records.display_vi: Trái Tim Sức Mạnh Trung Cấp — điều kiện và tăng thuộc tính cơ bản
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Ch87 inspection: a survivor or recruit at level 20 can use one Mid-tier Power Heart to break into third tier, with +100 to all BASE attributes. The source describes no failure chance at the eligible level and demonstrates Sarah's successful use. The +100 applies to core/base attributes only, explicitly NOT the bonuses supplied by equipment. This is different evidence from the first-merger market listing SX-0215, not proof that the source protagonist bought that marketplace listing.

source_effect_records.observed_effect: Merchant buys 346 units of viscous liquid in a single documented visit; game message shows 17,300 Krona credited. The implied unit rate 50 applies only to this observed lot; does not prove every region and season has fixed market price, or ongoing unlimited Black Lion demand.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not assign universal infinite NPC buy orders to the 50 Krona observed transaction.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 极品黑钻抵价与圣骑士之盾交易
source_effect_records.display_vi: Hắc Kim Cương — giá đề nghị và giao dịch cuối
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Black diamond described with ordinary market range 200k-400k, superior color up to 500k, source one extraordinary diamond initially quoted 950k Krona by Hilton. After negotiation the observed completed trade exchanges one diamond for one 900k list-price Paladin Shield plus 100k cash. This is a distinct final ~1,000,000 nominal consideration, not contradiction requiring overwriting 950k initial quote. No universal black diamond class price formula or infinite trade-in coupon.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: The 50k delta reflects negotiation; do not create extra 50k reward or claim all diamonds have identical rarity/value.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 黑狮商会建立贸易往来，商品九五折
source_effect_records.display_vi: Thương Hội Hắc Sư — quan hệ thương mại và giảm 5%
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Hilton requests a trading-point partnership when Cao Xing's territory prosperity is sufficient (source supplies no numeric threshold). Player explicitly ACCEPTS. Result sets Black Lion Merchant Guild favor to Friendly, allows future merchant visits as trade point, mentions merchant paying an unspecified service fee, and applies 95%-of-sticker-price purchase terms for future Black Lion goods. Chapter does not guarantee visit schedule, trader inventory, effect stacking with separate negotiated refugee prices or merchant fee amount.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not automatically enable the discount at T0 and do not stack on one-off haggled refugee-cohort pricing without a proven source order.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 树灵难民14名，招募前领地人口容量
source_effect_records.display_vi: Tiếp nhận 14 Thụ Linh: mua/đón tiếp và xét duyệt nhập lãnh địa
source_effect_records.observed_effect: Merchant carries 14 displaced Tree Spirits as refugees. Seller's opening market example is 5,000 Krona each (70,000 total); negotiated one-off group price is 65,000. They are invited as visitors first but the source lord waits until House level 2 increases population cap from 50 to 100 before officially inviting them to join; all 14 accept and loyalty begins at 60-70. This is one named source incident, not blanket NPC spawning or a global slave-shop price. The narrative describes their displacement and volunteered joining merchant's search for homes; recruitment requires invitation and acceptance.
source_effect_records.compatibility_warning: Do not assume buying cohort immediately overrides house capacity or causes automatic recruitment. Do not turn named refugees into random generic troop scrolls.

source_effect_records.source_name_zh: 领主小屋升至2级：人口上限和声望
source_effect_records.display_vi: Nhà Lãnh Chúa lên cấp 2 — sức chứa cư dân và danh vọng
source_effect_records.observed_effect: The inspected post-upgrade system notification gives +50 population cap, +200 reputation, resulting in 41/100 from 41/50 before upgrades and unlocking upgrading certain named buildings to level 2 (smithy, ore-processing plant, sewing shop, canteen, etc.). The source does not provide materials, precise construction time or a universal recipe for other levels.
